title: Peer/deliver contact_id check rejects all inbound group chat messages
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs:219: the sender verification checks existing.contact_id.as_deref() \!= Some(identity.user_id). Group chats store contact_id=NULL; None \!= Some(_) is always true, so every Peer/deliver to a group chat is rejected with 'chatId sender mismatch'. The commit adds get_members() for group fanout implying group receipt was intended. Any group chat created now permanently rejects all inbound messages.
